source.deviation: The lab baseline builds WHERE username = '...' AND password = '...'. This build was hardened in the Class 5 password lab: login() selects the row by username only and verifies the password separately in Python (Argon2 + legacy fallback). I did not re-introduce the old query. The no-password admin proof is the UNION payload, not the slide's admin' --.

union_payload.before_fix_result: SUCCESS - logged in as admin without admin's real password (login POST 302, admin GET 200)
union_payload.after_fix_result: BLOCKED - whole payload is one literal username (login POST 200, admin GET 302)

classic_lab_payload.before_fix_result: BLOCKED - login POST 200, admin GET 302 (redirect to login)
classic_lab_payload.note: This build verifies the password separately in Python (Class 5 Argon2 migration), so the lab's comment-out trick does not bypass login. I did not re-introduce the old query. The injection point was real before the fix; the same flaw #8 is proven with the UNION payload above.

flaw_8_sql_injection.side_effect_observed: Using id=1 in the UNION made the successful legacy-login upgrade write its replacement hash to the real admin row. Password reset to admin123 and verified by a fresh login; the stored hash is now Argon2id. For demonstration use a non-existent id (e.g. 999).
flaw_8_sql_injection.fix: Parameterised query: SELECT ... WHERE username = %s with (username,) tuple. No string concatenation.

payload.before_fix_result: SUCCESS - returned uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root) and /etc/passwd lines (root:x:0:0 ...)
payload.after_fix_result: BLOCKED - 'ping: 127.0.0.1; id; head -2 /etc/passwd: Name or service not known'; no uid=, no /etc/passwd

flaw_9_command_injection.fix: subprocess.run(["ping", "-c", "1", host], ...) argument list, shell=True removed. Host is a single argument, shell metacharacters are inert.

new_or_updated: tests/test_password_login.py: replaced the obsolete test that asserted the old SQL 'Query error' symptom; the replacement asserts a lone quote is literal data, no raw SQL error leaks for that input, and UNION cannot forge an admin login
tests/test_command_injection.py: new - ; $() and backtick payloads run no second command; /admin/ping requires an admin session
tests.negative_controls: The command-injection tests assert the absence of uid= and /etc/passwd. The positive control for a normal ping is evidence/after/part4_normal_features.txt.

coverage.note: Uncovered app.py lines are mostly other routes/flaws kept for later classes, outside this lab's scope.

data_integrity.seed_accounts: admin/admin123 and alice/alicepw logins verified; users/classes/notes/enrollments row counts 35/4/60/60.
data_integrity.note: The UNION demo used id=1, so the legacy-login upgrade wrote its replacement hash to the real admin row. The password was reset to admin123 and a fresh admin login was verified. The stored hash is now Argon2id, not the original seed plaintext. No notes/classes/enrollments were modified. A non-destructive demo uses id=999.
